text: {"lessons":["Taking gains in B, C and A felt rewarding, but selling should depend on each stock’s prospects and my target allocation—not simply the comfort of a realized profit.","Selling D at a loss was painful, but avoiding that pain is no reason to hold a weak investment; I should reassess it objectively and keep risk within limits.","I bought A again at a much higher price after selling it for a gain. I should judge it on its prospects today, avoid anchoring on my old sale price, and trade only when there is a clear reason."]}
